profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Full Stack Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Typescript, React.js, Node.js (Express), GraphQL, MongoDB, PostgresSQL, JavaScript, CI/CD Pipeline, Docker and Kubernetes. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Science (MS) focused in Computer Science from University of Mississippi, Oxford, MS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Full stack development of web applications to support various warehouse operations
- Take a lead on cloud services based solutions using AWS lambda, SQS, SNS, SES, etc.
- Contribute to end user facing e-commerce application
- Design solutions and write tech specs after gathering requirements from product
- Work with project team to ensure requirements and proposed solution meet standards.
- Analyze and estimate work for future projects
- Interviewing and mentoring junior developers
positions.insights: Skills: React · Material-UI · AWS Lambda · Amazon SQS · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) · Amazon S3 · Microservices · Node.js · Terraform · Algolia

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing and maintaining front-end of the web application written using React, Redux, ES6, HTML, CSS, GraphQL Client
- Developing and maintaining back-end API server written using Node.js, Express, GraphQL, Python (fast-api)
- Setting up Travis build and deploying application to Cloud (AWS, GCP, Heroku) using Kubernetes container
- Creating and maintaining Tableau Server deployment to AWS/GCP compute engine
- Structuring user data collections and writing optimized queries to pull those data from MongoDB
- Creating data visualization charts using Highcharts, Zoomcharts, d3, Recharts charting libraries and writing efficient queries to pull required data from PostgreSQL and/or ElasticSearch
- Optimizing performance of the front-end applications using lazy loading, code splitting and analysing the bundle size
- Implementing unit tests and e2e test using jest and puppeteer
- Defining technical requirements based upon business requirements
positions.insights: Skills: Test-Driven Development · AWS CloudFormation · Content Management Systems (CMS) · NestJS · React · Next · PostgreSQL · Elasticsearch · Amazon EKS · AWS EC2 · AWS ECR · GraphQL · Amazon Cognito · Highcharts · D3.js · Vercel · Oauth2 · SAML 2.0

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed a web app for Printer that works as an entry point for providing Cloud support on Printer to manage the Printer remotely using Java, Java Servlets, JSON, Apache Http client, REST calls, html, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX, OAuth2.0, Ant, Jenkins, Git, Gerrit-Review
•	Collaborated closely with Cloud team to plan, design and develop robust solutions
•	Developed test environment using JUnit to simulate Cloud environment
•	Implemented automated GUI tests using lettuce (Selenium with Python)
•	Modified existing SDK to correct errors, upgrade interfaces and improve performance

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Working as a Teaching Assistant for Robotics and Computer Networking in Spring 2016. 
Worked as a Teaching Assistant for C++ in Fall 2015.
Worked as a Teaching Assistant for Algorithm and Data Structure Analysis in Spring 2015.  
Worked as a Teaching Assistant for Java in Fall 2014.
Worked as a Teaching Assistant for MatLab in Spring 2014.

company.name: Department of Computer and Information Science, University of Mississippi

positions.title: Data Center Operator
positions.description:
•	Receiving requests from employees and providing requested information 
•	Maintaining the data centre of the organization and ensuring that the systems run properly 
•	Ensuring security of the systems and monitor any unauthorized entry 
•	Ensure that employees are provided with the information without delay 
•	Organize data in the computer as per specifications of the organization management 
•	Assist in data recovery and disaster management in case there is a security breach or data is lost 
•	Prepare backup for systems so that data is not lost if there is a problem with the system 
•	May also have to monitor security and working of organization servers 
•	Document all the requests and follow organization rules and procedures before providing information 
•	Regularly monitor security arrangements and upgrade security measures

projects.title: Enticy Stuff (Retail Ecommerce Site)
projects.description: An ecommerce site for arts and craft products. Products can be added dynamically through CMS (Contentful). Auth0 is used as third party authentication app. Stripe is used to handle payments.

projects.title: Template Explorer
projects.description: A react web application to explore website templates. It includes CRUD operations using REST API.
